property_summary: For every call to transfer(...), the reference C always reverts if the _tos array is empty (so the call cannot succeed with zero recipients); the mutant removes that check and therefore allows a successful return when _tos is empty, violating this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to allow zero-length arrays (remove the check) so transfer can be called with an empty _tos without reverting.
